entries.reviewFinding: Printed five/two/two are battery families, not physical barrel counts or arcs. Stock CL17 and later CL19 variant must remain separate; the tactical-fire condition step is conditional on a successful ally attack reaching threshold.

evidenceClaims.observation: Five turbolaser batteries +13; two point-defense laser batteries +13; two ion cannon batteries +13
Forgo attacks as standard action: allied hit dealing at least target damage threshold causes an extra condition step for enemy starfighter within two starship squares
Later refit raises rate of fire, consumables to one year, recharge shields +10 SR, lowers fighter complement from 24 to 12; revised CL 19 versus printed stock CL 17

entries.reviewFinding: Two gunners operating four guns are not four extra attack actions. Third gunner's tractor and missiles share operating station; source publishes no per-mount arc. Gamma shield depletion differs from the default threshold-based model.

evidenceClaims.observation: Four turbolasers +6 distributed among two gunners
Third gunner operates the missile launcher and tractor beam; printed payload fifteen medium concussion missiles
Any successful attack reduces SR by five even without penetration; if damage exceeds SR, all SR immediately becomes zero

entries.printedName: Kuat Drive Yards Imperial II-class Star Destroyer
entries.reviewFinding: Preserve 5+5 printed combat battery declarations and p97 twenty-battery narrative separately; also preserve two tractor attack batteries versus ten generators. Neither page explains full mount-to-group cardinality or firing arcs. This is an unresolved aggregation/provenance question, not license to overwrite either.

evidenceClaims.observation: Five heavy turbolaser batteries, five turbolaser batteries, four heavy ion cannon batteries, two tractor beam batteries
Narrative describes twenty turbolaser batteries and ten tractor beam generators
Standard action forfeits attacks; friendly ships gain +2 attack against targets within two-square radius

entries.printedName: Rendili StarDrive Victory II-class Star Destroyer
entries.reviewFinding: Interception role is not a printed gravity well weapon. No published payload line is a source-silence/row-absence state, not numeric zero; preserve no missile row without inventing launcher counts for either version.

evidenceClaims.observation: Four heavy turbolaser batteries +14, four double turbolaser batteries +14, two heavy ion cannon batteries +14, two tractor beam batteries +14
Victory II attack statblock has no missiles; text contrasts Victory I limited ordnance dependence
Ship used for interception and ion/tractor capture; no gravity-well projector stat line

entries.reviewFinding: Original Vindicator retains its statblock and guns. No gravity-well capability should be borrowed from the distinct Immobilizer. The printed battery counts still cannot establish physical weapon number and firing geometry.

evidenceClaims.observation: Five light quad turbolaser batteries +12, five light turbolaser batteries +14, four point-defense laser batteries +14, four point-defense ion batteries +14, one tractor beam battery +16
Immobilizer 418 created by replacing Vindicator firepower with gravity-well projectors
One tractor beam battery requires six gunners, not six projectors

entries.reviewFinding: CP16 already retains two physically linked lasers. Pair does not certify the arcs or independently operating weapons. Contextual effective size must not replace actual printed ship type.

evidenceClaims.observation: Narrative describes a pair of linked laser cannons operated from a gunner's station
Though Colossal transport, Gargantuan starfighter treatment only for capital-weapon targeting, dogfighting and starship maneuvers
Printed hyperdrive x.5; no stock separate launcher or missile stat line

row.hardwareCountBasis: p103 narrative: modest pair of linked lasers

entries.reviewFinding: Do not turn stock crew stations into independent physical cannons. The military ten-cannon configuration is a separate variant; passenger/cargo/troop conversions are alternatives, not stacked capacities.

evidenceClaims.observation: Blaster cannon battery +6 operated by two gunners, blaster cannon +4 by copilot, twin laser cannon +6 by pilot
Deck plan shows pilot, copilot, and gunnery stations; no published weapon arcs
Ten-laser heavily armed militarized Cygnus version described separately, not printed stock Sienar Lambda loadout

entries.reviewFinding: Four batteries times five gunners does not prove twenty physical guns. SR halving is localized and target-size gated, not permanent SR damage, and Fowler's drive is unique.

evidenceClaims.observation: Four point-defense quad laser cannon batteries +12, each five gunners
Forfeit attacks; shields of enemy starfighters of Gargantuan size or smaller are halved in adjacent squares
Rebel captured Fowler Lancer had improved hyperdrive; not stock configuration

entries.printedName: Feethan Ottraw Scalable Industries Mankvim-814 Light Interceptor
entries.reviewFinding: This is a droid-piloted cockpit ship, not Crew 0 autonomous virtual gunner craft. No missile attack group, barrel count or firing arc can be assumed.

evidenceClaims.observation: Crew one droid pilot; a living pilot can operate cockpit
Light laser cannons +4 (pilot), 2d10x2
Capabilities state no hyperdrive, short single-system range

entries.reviewFinding: CP16 explicitly retains the four cannon count; a singular gunner weapon subrow does not establish individual stations, arcs or firing batteries. Rebel hospital and supply refits are not automatically installed.

evidenceClaims.observation: Four point-defense double laser cannons +1 (gunner), 4d10x2
Medium transport carries 19,000 tons and has stock defense for escape, not warship combat
Alliance-upgraded transports may have improved weapons, shields or engines; distinct from stock statblock

entries.reviewFinding: Do not import the command loadout or later R2 protection into baseline Fighter. Conditional astromech skill bonuses and missile physical launcher count remain separate from six-round ammunition.

evidenceClaims.observation: Laser cannons +7 OR medium concussion missiles +7; six missiles are ammunition
Command fighter adds third laser cannon, two ion cannons and another missile launcher
Earlier fighter R2 external socket; later enclosed R2 with greater protection

entries.reviewFinding: Bomber is not an upgrade magically sharing stock Fighter one-pilot firing rights. Separate AND group semantics and gunner role are printed, but launcher number and arcs still lack evidence.

evidenceClaims.observation: Laser cannons +7 (pilot) AND medium concussion missiles +7 (gunner); 32 carried missiles
Two crew plus astromech; separate gunner for missile attack
Fighter has pilot OR alternatives and six missiles, not bomber's 32-missile arrangement

entries.reviewFinding: The MC80 shield recharge is not an unconditional every-round passive regeneration. Keep tactical aura contingent on surviving source shield, and retain four/five/one attack battery groups without inventing cannon counts or arcs.

evidenceClaims.observation: Four turbolaser batteries +15; five heavy ion batteries +11; one tractor battery +15
Three swift actions restore 10 shield rating, rather than five
Standard action forgo attacks; friendly ships within two squares gain +10 SR only when MC80 itself still has SR greater than zero

entries.reviewFinding: Named Home One is a published subclass but is not interchangeable with stock MC80. Keep 6/6/1 vs 4/5/1 groups and 120 vs 36 fighters, and do not silently grant or deny MC80-class shield/tactical rule inheritance without scoped authority.

evidenceClaims.observation: Home One described as MC80 subclass with separately printed statblock
Six turbolaser batteries +15; six heavy ion batteries +15; one tractor beam battery +15
Home One carries 120 fighters; ordinary MC80 carries 36
Generic MC80 tactical/shield abilities appear before Home One; published Home One statblock does not separately repeat them

entries.printedName: Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps N-1 Royal Starfighter
entries.reviewFinding: Ten proton torpedoes are payload, not installed launcher count. Fire-link is an attack option, not evidence for additional mounts; pilot/astromech skills and cover remain separately conditional.

evidenceClaims.observation: Laser cannons +6 OR proton torpedoes +6, fire-link available; ten torpedoes carried
Mechanics +6 and Use Computer +6, starred +13 with astromech; astro ten-jump memory and +5 cover
Pilot total cover distinct from astromech +5 cover
